nodes.event: The IDS reports web-01 sending data to 203.0.113.50 every few seconds.

choices.label: Disable web-01's switch port
choices.attacker: The attacker has no path back to web-01.
choices.tradeoff: Stops the transfer at once and leaves the host and its memory as they are.

choices.label: Keep watching the traffic for another hour
choices.attacker: The attacker copies the rest of the database.
choices.tradeoff: Gives more data to look at, and gives the attacker the whole database.

nodes.event: The transfer ended with the data gone.

checkpoints.title: web-01 is isolated from the network.
